Subject: Initial onboarding docs / missing PO number

Hi Markus / Laura,

Thanks again for taking our call last week. We kicked off the vendor onboarding flow and uploaded the forms requested (onboarding_form.pdf and vendor_w9.pdf attached), but the vendor portal is still showing "Form mismatch / legal entity not found" and hasn't issued a PO number. Our finance team is blocked from creating the supplier invoice until a PO is assigned.

Could you confirm what field is mismatching? On our side the legal name is "BrickWave, Inc." and the tax ID matches the W9. If you need a specific template or signature line from your procurement system, happy to resend.

We have an initial invoice we need to submit next week — ideally we'd have a provisional PO or temporary hold so work can continue while you resolve the onboarding metadata.

Attachments: onboarding_form.pdf (fillable), vendor_w9.pdf

Thanks,
Elise Thornton

Laura — quick heads up, BrickWave uploaded the forms but the onboarding record is flagging a mismatch on the registered legal entity vs. the portal drop-down. Monica and I discussed a short-term path: can procurement issue a provisional PO (temp PO code) capped at $25k so they can submit the first invoice, while we iron out entity metadata?

If a provisional PO is possible, please note the following:
- Spend cap: $25,000 provisional (until paperwork reconciled)
- Line items: need to align to our internal ledger codes (I can paste mapping below once we confirm)
- Expiration: 30 days from issue unless extended by procurement

Laura — can you confirm who on your team will own the entity verification? If procurement needs corrected forms from the vendor, please send the checklist back to Elise.

Markus Klein

From: laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>

Date: 2026-10-29T11:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Initial onboarding docs / missing PO number

Hi Elise — thanks for the upload and heads-up. I pulled the portal record and here's what procurement needs to proceed:

Checklist / action items for BrickWave (please revise and resend):
1) Confirm exact legal entity name as it appears on state filing and W9 (we're seeing "Brickwave LLC" vs. "BrickWave, Inc." on different docs).
2) Supplier address must include the business address (not a mailing/PO box) in the portal registration.
3) Add a primary AP contact in the onboarding form with phone & email.
4) Re-attach W9 as a flattened PDF (sometimes the portal OCR fails on editable forms).

Provisionally, procurement can issue a temporary PO stub to unblock the first invoice:
- Provisional PO issued: PO-TEMP-2026-0897 (will be created in the system today)
- Spend cap: $25,000
- Allowed line items: services (SVC-101), one-time onboarding fee (ONB-420). Any invoices outside these codes will be routed for manual approval and hold.
- Expiry: 2026-11-29 unless earlier cleared

I've attached a provisional_PO_stub.pdf for your records — it is non-billable until the legal entity and address are reconciled. Once you send updated onboarding_form_v2 and a flattened W9, procurement will validate and convert the provisional PO to a standard PO.

Laura Bennett
Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com
Attachment: provisional_PO_stub.pdf

From: Elise Thornton <elise.thornton@brickwave.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com
Cc: markus_klein@redwoodinference.com, monica_patel@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2026-10-30T15:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Initial onboarding docs / missing PO number

Hi Laura / Markus — thanks, that helps. Attached are the updated files: updated_onboarding_form_v2.pdf (we corrected the legal entity line to "BrickWave, Inc."), and a flattened vendor_w9.pdf plus a pricing_sheet.xlsx with line-item codes filled as requested.

Quick questions from our AP: when the provisional PO converts to the standard PO, will the PO number change? We just want to ensure invoices reference the correct final PO for matching. Also confirming acceptance of the provisional spend cap ($25k) — that works for us.

For clarity, we've included the same pricing matrix in the spreadsheet with codes SVC-101 and ONB-420. If procurement needs any additional signatures (PO acceptance page or SOW), tell us and we'll sign promptly.

Elise Thornton
Head of Finance Ops
BrickWave
Attachment: updated_onboarding_form_v2.pdf, pricing_sheet.xlsx
